purpose: Post-hoc sensitivity and paired-replica diagnostic; not production replacement
caveats: Only five replica pairs; resampling is exploratory.
Same-replica windows and stress channels are kept together.
Fixed cutoffs are sensitivity tests, not selected final viscosity estimates.

paired_swap_test.assumption: Exchangeability of the two windows within a replica under the stationary null; only five pairs and no guarantee of independence between reservoir-spaced replicas.
